_comment_personal: Personal local deployment — stdio, single client. Drop this in your project root next to groove.toml, or point Claude Code at it via `~/.config/claude/.mcp.json`.
_comment_config: `--config` names the file rather than letting groove discover it, which is what makes it trusted. A config found beside a project is honoured only in part: [parsers], grammar_dir, fastembed_cache_dir, kb_path and the [transport.http] gates are reset to safe defaults with a warning, so a project-scoped groove.toml would silently index Markdown alone. `./groove.toml` resolves against the directory the client launches groove from — replace it with an absolute path if your client does not set that to the project root. See docs/configuration.md, 'Trusted and untrusted config locations'.
_comment_alwaysLoad: alwaysLoad: true is a Claude Code v2.1.121+ option that ensures groove's tools are present at initial load (skips tool-search lookup latency). Other MCP clients (Cursor, etc.) ignore the field. Drop it if first-startup model download cost outweighs the latency win.
